Sam H.: Quick heads up — hotfix PR #1209 needs two approvers before the 18:00 PT cutoff. CI is mostly green but we should get one more pair of eyes on the cache migration change. Anyone free to take a quick look? :clock2:

Lia M.: I can look in 10. What files are the risky bits?

Sam H.: Mostly runtime/cache/* and the DB migration script. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1209

Devon K.: I'll pick this up now. If CI stays green I'll sign off.

Jen P.: FYI the alpha canary saw a spike in rpc latency when I ran the smoke suite locally — small blip but worth verifying the migration doesn't regress perf. Repro snippet: ```bash
./scripts/run-smoke --target=canary --samples=100
```

Sam H.: thanks @Jen P., can you run that on the canary quickly and paste the output?

Jen P.: ran it — tail of output attached (pasted): 
`95th: 120ms -> baseline 85ms (3 runs)`, looks like a transient around warmup.

Devon K.: I see the hotspot: we forgot an early-exit in cache warm path. Pushing quick patch to PR now.

ops-bot: CI status for PR #1209: checks/ci — passed; checks/integration — running (2/3); security/scan — passed.

Lia M.: quick code note: in runtime/cache/manager.go L45-L56 the new code holds the lock during network fetch; can we reduce lock scope? small inline comment incoming.

Devon K.: pushed patch and responded to Lia's comment. Integration job requeued.

ops-bot: checks/integration for PR #1209 — passed.

Sam H.: Awesome. @Lia M. can you give second LGTM when you get a sec? We need 2x before cutoff or we'll delay the roll. :pray:

Lia M.: LGTM after the lock-scope nit — left one tiny suggestion but not blocking. :thumbsup:

Sam H.: Devon, do you still want to be approver?

Devon K.: Yup, giving LGTM now. 

Sam H.: Great — merged and scheduled for the 19:00 deploy window. Thanks all for the quick turnaround :rocket:
